note: The asset registry (platform/data-assets). Tools reference assets by id and version only. Hosts check every file against its sha256 before supplying it to the core. Files with loadPolicy on-demand live under assets/data/<id>/<version>/ in a clone and are served from /assets/<id>/<version>/ on the web.
